text: It is a little remarkable, that—though disinclined to talk overmuch of myself and my affairs at the fireside, and to my personal friends—an autobiographical impulse should twice in my life have taken possession of me, in addressing the public.
chunks: It is a little remarkable, that— though disinclined to talk overmuch
of myself and my affairs at the fireside,
and to my personal friends— an autobiographical impulse should twice
in my life have taken possession
of me, in addressing the public.

text: It will be seen, likewise, that this Custom-House sketch has a certain propriety, of a kind always recognised in literature, as explaining how a large portion of the following pages came into my possession, and as offering proofs of the authenticity of a narrative therein contained.
chunks: It will be seen, likewise, that this Custom-House sketch has a certain propriety,
of a kind always recognised
in literature, as explaining how a large portion
of the following pages came into my possession, and as offering proofs
of the authenticity of a narrative therein contained.

text: But she has no great tenderness even in her best of moods, and, sooner or later—oftener soon than late—is apt to fling off her nestlings with a scratch of her claw, a dab of her beak, or a rankling wound from her barbed arrows.
zh: 但即使在心情最好的时候，她也没有多大的温柔，而且，迟早——通常是早比晚——她很容易用爪子抓一下，用喙轻拍一下，或者用带刺的箭射出令人痛心的伤口，把雏鸟扔掉。
chunks: But she has no great tenderness even in her best of moods, and,
sooner or later— oftener soon than late—
is apt to fling off her nestlings with a scratch
of her claw, a dab
of her beak, or a rankling wound from her barbed arrows.

text: Here, likewise—the germ of the wrinkle-browed, grizzly-bearded, careworn merchant—we have the smart young clerk, who gets the taste of traffic as a wolf-cub does of blood, and already sends adventures in his master’s ships, when he had better be sailing mimic boats upon a mill-pond.
chunks: Here, likewise— the germ of the wrinkle-browed, grizzly-bearded, careworn merchant—
we have the smart young clerk, who gets the taste of traffic
as a wolf-cub does of blood,
and already sends adventures in his master’s ships,
when he had better be sailing mimic boats upon a mill-pond.

text: All three give glimpses of the shops of grocers, block-makers, slop-sellers, and ship-chandlers, around the doors of which are generally to be seen, laughing and gossiping, clusters of old salts, and such other wharf-rats as haunt the Wapping of a seaport.
chunks: All three give glimpses of the shops
of grocers, block-makers, slop-sellers, and ship-chandlers, around the doors
of which are generally to be seen, laughing and gossiping,
clusters of old salts, and such other wharf-rats
as haunt the Wapping of a seaport.

text: It is now nearly two centuries and a quarter since the original Briton, the earliest emigrant of my name, made his appearance in the wild and forest-bordered settlement which has since become a city.
zh: 自从最初的英国人（我的名字中最早的移民）出现在这个被森林包围的荒野定居点（后来成为一座城市）以来，已经过去了近两个世纪又四分之一的时间。
chunks: It is now nearly two centuries
and a quarter since the original Briton,
the earliest emigrant of my name,
made his appearance in the wild
and forest-bordered settlement which has since become a city.

text: It still haunts me, and induces a sort of home-feeling with the past, which I scarcely claim in reference to the present phase of the town.
zh: 它仍然困扰着我，并引起一种对过去的家的感觉，我几乎没有在提到城镇的现状时声称这种感觉。
chunks: It still haunts me,
and induces a sort
of home-feeling with the past,
which I scarcely claim in reference
to the present phase of the town.

text: At all events, I, the present writer, as their representative, hereby take shame upon myself for their sakes, and pray that any curse incurred by them—as I have heard, and as the dreary and unprosperous condition of the race, for many a long year back, would argue to exist—may be now and henceforth removed.
chunks: At all events, I, the present writer, as their representative,
hereby take shame upon myself for their sakes, and pray
that any curse incurred by them— as I have heard, and as the dreary
and unprosperous condition of the race, for many a long year back, would argue to exist—
may be now and henceforth removed.

text: Why, the degenerate fellow might as well have been a fiddler!
zh: 哎呀，这个堕落的家伙还不如当个小提琴手呢！
chunks: Why,
the degenerate fellow might
as well have been a fiddler!

text: It is not love but instinct.
zh: 这不是爱，而是本能。
chunks: It is not love
but instinct.

text: My children have had other birth-places, and, so far as their fortunes may be within my control, shall strike their roots into unaccustomed earth.
zh: 我的孩子们有过其他的出生地，只要他们的命运在我的掌控之中，他们就会在不习惯的土地上扎根。
chunks: My children have had other birth-places, and,
so far as their fortunes may be
within my control,
shall strike their roots
into unaccustomed earth.

text: The whereabouts of the Oldest Inhabitant was at once settled when I looked at them.
zh: 当我看到他们的时候，我立刻就确定了最老居民的行踪。
chunks: The whereabouts
of the Oldest Inhabitant was at once settled when I looked at them.

text: I must plead guilty to the charge of abbreviating the official breath of more than one of these venerable servants of the republic.
zh: 我必须认罪，因为我曾对共和国的这些令人尊敬的公仆中的一位以上进行过缩短公务的指控。
chunks: I must plead guilty to the charge
of abbreviating the official breath
of more than one
of these venerable servants
of the republic.

text: According to the received code in such matters, it would have been nothing short of duty, in a politician, to bring every one of those white heads under the axe of the guillotine.
zh: 根据在此类问题上所接受的准则，作为一个政治家，将每一个白头都送上断头台是义不容辞的责任。
chunks: According to the received code in such matters,
it would have been nothing short
of duty, in a politician,
to bring every one of those white heads
under the axe of the guillotine.

text: So, with lightsome hearts and the happy consciousness of being usefully employed—in their own behalf at least, if not for our beloved country—these good old gentlemen went through the various formalities of office.
zh: 因此，怀着轻松的心情和对自己有用的快乐意识——至少是为了他们自己的利益，如果不是为了我们深爱的国家——这些善良的老绅士们办理了各种公务手续。
chunks: So, with lightsome hearts and the happy consciousness
of being usefully employed— in their own behalf
at least, if not for our beloved country—
these good old gentlemen went
through the various formalities of office.

text: As most of these old Custom-House officers had good traits, and as my position in reference to them, being paternal and protective, was favourable to the growth of friendly sentiments, I soon grew to like them all.
zh: 由于这些老海关官员大多都有良好的品质，而且我对他们的态度是慈父般的、保护性的，有利于友好感情的增长，所以我很快就喜欢上了他们所有人。
chunks: As most of these old Custom-House officers had good traits,
and as my position in reference to them,
being paternal and protective, was favourable to the growth
of friendly sentiments, I soon grew
to like them all.

text: But, as respects the majority of my corps of veterans, there will be no wrong done if I characterize them generally as a set of wearisome old souls, who had gathered nothing worth preservation from their varied experience of life.
zh: 但是，就我的大多数退伍军人而言，如果我将他们概括为一群令人厌烦的老灵魂，他们从不同的生活经历中没有收集到任何值得保存的东西，那就没有什么错。
chunks: But, as respects the majority of my corps of veterans,
there will be no wrong done if I characterize them generally
as a set of wearisome old souls,
who had gathered nothing worth preservation
from their varied experience of life.

text: His voice and laugh, which perpetually re-echoed through the Custom-House, had nothing of the tremulous quaver and cackle of an old man’s utterance; they came strutting out of his lungs, like the crow of a cock, or the blast of a clarion.
chunks: His voice and laugh, which perpetually re-echoed
through the Custom-House, had nothing of the tremulous quaver and cackle
of an old man’s utterance; they came strutting out of his lungs,
like the crow of a cock,
or the blast of a clarion.

text: Here, one would suppose, might have been sorrow enough to imbue the sunniest disposition through and through with a sable tinge.
zh: 人们可能会想，这里可能已经充满了悲伤，足以让最阳光的性格自始至终都被染上一层貂皮色彩。
chunks: Here, one would suppose,
might have been sorrow enough
to imbue the sunniest disposition
through and
through with a sable tinge.

text: My conclusion was that he had no soul, no heart, no mind; nothing, as I have already said, but instincts; and yet, withal, so cunningly had the few materials of his character been put together that there was no painful perception of deficiency, but, on my part, an entire contentment with what I found in him.
chunks: My conclusion was that he had no soul,
no heart, no mind; nothing, as I have already said,
but instincts; and yet, withal, so cunningly had the few materials
of his character been put together that there was no painful perception
of deficiency, but, on my part, an entire contentment with what I found in him.

text: But it is time to quit this sketch; on which, however, I should be glad to dwell at considerably more length, because of all men whom I have ever known, this individual was fittest to be a Custom-House officer.
zh: 但现在是时候放弃这个草图了；然而，我很乐意花更多的篇幅来讨论这个问题，因为在我所认识的所有人中，这个人最适合担任海关官员。
chunks: But it is time to quit this sketch; on which, however,
I should be glad to dwell
at considerably more length, because of all men
whom I have ever known, this individual was fittest
to be a Custom-House officer.

text: The step was palsied now, that had been foremost in the charge.
zh: 冲锋中最先冲锋的脚步现在已经麻木了。
chunks: The step was palsied now,
that had been foremost
in the charge.

text: It was not painful to behold this look; for, though dim, it had not the imbecility of decaying age.
zh: 看到这样的表情，我并不感到痛苦。因为，虽然昏暗，但它并没有衰老的愚蠢。
chunks: It was not painful
to behold this look; for,
though dim,
it had not the imbecility
of decaying age.

text: His spirit could never, I conceive, have been characterized by an uneasy activity; it must, at any period of his life, have required an impulse to set him in motion; but once stirred up, with obstacles to overcome, and an adequate object to be attained, it was not in the man to give out or fail.
chunks: His spirit could never, I conceive, have been characterized by an uneasy activity; it must, at any period
of his life, have required an impulse to set him in motion;
but once stirred up, with obstacles to overcome,
and an adequate object to be attained, it was not
in the man to give out or fail.

text: I have not known the man to whose innate kindliness I would more confidently make an appeal.
zh: 我不知道有哪个人能让我更有信心地向他的与生俱来的善良求助。
chunks: I have not known the man
to whose innate kindliness I would more confidently make an appeal.

text: An old soldier might be supposed to prize only the bloody laurel on his brow; but here was one who seemed to have a young girl’s appreciation of the floral tribe.
zh: 一个老战士可能应该只珍视他额头上的血腥桂冠；但这个人似乎对花卉部落有着年轻女孩的欣赏能力。
chunks: An old soldier might be supposed
to prize only the bloody laurel on his brow;
but here was one who seemed
to have a young girl’s appreciation
of the floral tribe.

text: There was one thing that much aided me in renewing and re-creating the stalwart soldier of the Niagara frontier—the man of true and simple energy.
zh: 有一件事情对我更新和重建尼亚加拉边境的坚定战士有很大帮助——一个真正而简单的能量的人。
chunks: There was one thing
that much aided me in renewing
and re-creating the stalwart soldier
of the Niagara frontier—
the man of true and simple energy.

text: His gifts were emphatically those of a man of business; prompt, acute, clear-minded; with an eye that saw through all perplexities, and a faculty of arrangement that made them vanish as by the waving of an enchanter’s wand.
chunks: His gifts were emphatically those of a man
of business; prompt, acute, clear-minded;
with an eye that saw through all perplexities,
and a faculty of arrangement
that made them vanish as by the waving of an enchanter’s wand.

text: His integrity was perfect; it was a law of nature with him, rather than a choice or a principle; nor can it be otherwise than the main condition of an intellect so remarkably clear and accurate as his to be honest and regular in the administration of affairs.
chunks: His integrity was perfect; it was a law
of nature with him, rather than a choice or a principle;
nor can it be otherwise than the main condition
of an intellect so remarkably clear
and accurate as his to be honest and regular in the administration of affairs.

text: I looked upon it as an evidence, in some measure, of a system naturally well balanced, and lacking no essential part of a thorough organization, that, with such associates to remember, I could mingle at once with men of altogether different qualities, and never murmur at the change.
chunks: I looked upon it as an evidence, in some measure,
of a system naturally well balanced,
and lacking no essential part of a thorough organization, that,
with such associates to remember, I could mingle at once with men
of altogether different qualities, and never murmur at the change.

text: It might be true, indeed, that this was a life which could not, with impunity, be lived too long; else, it might make me permanently other than I had been, without transforming me into any shape which it would be worth my while to take.
zh: 确实，这种生活可能确实不能活得太久而不受惩罚。否则，它可能会让我永远不同于以前，而不会把我变成任何值得我花时间去改变的形状。
chunks: It might be true, indeed, that this was a life
which could not, with impunity, be lived too long; else,
it might make me permanently other than I had been,
without transforming me into any shape
which it would be worth my while to take.

text: I know not that I especially needed the lesson, either in the way of warning or rebuke; but at any rate, I learned it thoroughly: nor, it gives me pleasure to reflect, did the truth, as it came home to my perception, ever cost me a pang, or require to be thrown off in a sigh.
chunks: I know not that I especially needed the lesson, either in the way of warning or rebuke;
but at any rate, I learned it thoroughly: nor,
it gives me pleasure to reflect, did the truth,
as it came home to my perception, ever cost me a pang,
or require to be thrown off in a sigh.

text: But the past was not dead.
zh: 但过去并没有消亡。
chunks: But the
past was not dead.

text: At one end of the room, in a recess, were a number of barrels piled one upon another, containing bundles of official documents.
zh: 房间一端的凹处里堆放着许多桶，里面装着一捆捆的官方文件。
chunks: At one end of the room,
in a recess, were a number
of barrels piled one
upon another, containing bundles
of official documents.

text: British army in its flight from Boston.
zh: 英国军队从波士顿撤离。
chunks: British army
in its flight from Boston.

text: I remembered to have read (probably in Felt’s “Annals”) a notice of the decease of Mr.
zh: 我记得读过（可能是在费尔特的《年鉴》中）一则关于先生去世的通知。
chunks: I remembered
to have read (probably in Felt’s “Annals”) a notice of the decease of Mr.

text: On the transfer of the archives to Halifax, this package, proving to be of no public concern, was left behind, and had remained ever since unopened.
zh: 在档案转移到哈利法克斯后，这个包裹被证明与公众无关，因此被留下，并且从那时起就一直没有被打开过。
chunks: On the transfer of the archives
to Halifax, this package, proving to be
of no public concern,
was left behind,
and had remained ever since unopened.

text: As a final disposition I contemplate depositing them with the Essex Historical Society.
zh: 作为最后的处理，我考虑将它们存放在埃塞克斯历史学会。
chunks: As a final disposition I contemplate depositing them
with the Essex Historical Society.

text: And yet it strangely interested me.
zh: 但奇怪的是，它却让我感兴趣。
chunks: And yet it
strangely interested me.

text: In the absorbing contemplation of the scarlet letter, I had hitherto neglected to examine a small roll of dingy paper, around which it had been twisted.
zh: 在对红字的引人入胜的沉思中，我迄今为止都忽略了检查一小卷肮脏的纸，它被扭曲在上面。
chunks: In the absorbing contemplation of the scarlet letter,
I had hitherto neglected
to examine a small roll
of dingy paper,
around which it had been twisted.

text: I must not be understood affirming that, in the dressing up of the tale, and imagining the motives and modes of passion that influenced the characters who figure in it, I have invariably confined myself within the limits of the old Surveyor’s half-a-dozen sheets of foolscap.
chunks: I must not be understood affirming that, in the dressing up of the tale,
and imagining the motives and modes of passion
that influenced the characters who figure in it,
I have invariably confined myself within the limits
of the old Surveyor’s half-a-dozen sheets of foolscap.

text: In his port was the dignity of one who had borne His Majesty’s commission, and who was therefore illuminated by a ray of the splendour that shone so dazzlingly about the throne.
zh: 在他的港口里，有一位接受过国王陛下委托的人的尊严，因此他被王座周围耀眼的光芒所照亮。
chunks: In his port was the dignity of one
who had borne His Majesty’s commission,
and who was therefore illuminated
by a ray of the splendour
that shone so dazzlingly about the throne.

text: And I said to the ghost of Mr. Surveyor Pue—“I will”.
zh: 我对测量员普埃先生的鬼魂说——“我会的”。
chunks: And I said
to the ghost
of Mr. Surveyor Pue—
“I will”.

text: And, to say the truth, an appetite, sharpened by the east wind that generally blew along the passage, was the only valuable result of so much indefatigable exercise.
zh: 而且，说实话，被沿着通道吹过的东风所增强的食欲，是这么多不知疲倦的锻炼的唯一有价值的结果。
chunks: And, to say the truth, an appetite,
sharpened by the east wind
that generally blew along the passage,
was the only valuable result
of so much indefatigable exercise.

text: What have you to do with us?” that expression seemed to say.
zh: 你和我们有什么关系？”那表情似乎在说。
chunks: What have you
to do with us?” that expression seemed to say.

text: It went with me on my sea-shore walks and rambles into the country, whenever—which was seldom and reluctantly—I bestirred myself to seek that invigorating charm of Nature which used to give me such freshness and activity of thought, the moment that I stepped across the threshold of the Old Manse.
chunks: It went with me on my sea-shore walks and rambles
into the country, whenever— which was seldom and reluctantly—
I bestirred myself to seek that invigorating charm of Nature which used
to give me such freshness and activity of thought, the moment
that I stepped across the threshold of the Old Manse.

text: Ghosts might enter here without affrighting us.
zh: 鬼魂可能会进入这里而不会吓到我们。
chunks: Ghosts might enter here
without affrighting us.

text: Glancing at the looking-glass, we behold—deep within its haunted verge—the smouldering glow of the half-extinguished anthracite, the white moon-beams on the floor, and a repetition of all the gleam and shadow of the picture, with one remove further from the actual, and nearer to the imaginative.
chunks: Glancing at the looking-glass, we behold— deep within its haunted verge—
the smouldering glow of the half-extinguished anthracite, the white moon-beams on the floor,
and a repetition of all the gleam
and shadow of the picture, with one remove further
from the actual, and nearer to the imaginative.

text: Could I have preserved the picturesque force of his style, and the humourous colouring which nature taught him how to throw over his descriptions, the result, I honestly believe, would have been something new in literature.
zh: 如果我能够保留他风格中如画般的力量，以及大自然教他如何摆脱描述的幽默色彩，我真诚地相信，结果将是文学中的新事物。
chunks: Could I have preserved the picturesque force
of his style, and the humourous colouring
which nature taught him how to throw
over his descriptions, the result, I honestly believe,
would have been something new in literature.

text: These perceptions had come too late.
zh: 这些看法来得太晚了。
chunks: These perceptions had
come too late.

text: In some other form, perhaps, I may hereafter develop these effects.
zh: 也许，我以后可能会以其他形式发挥这些效果。
chunks: In some other form, perhaps,
I may hereafter develop these effects.

text: He usually keeps his ground just long enough for his own ruin, and is then thrust out, with sinews all unstrung, to totter along the difficult footpath of life as he best may.
zh: 他通常会坚持自己的立场，直到自己毁灭为止，然后就被推了出去，筋疲力尽，尽其所能地沿着艰难的人生道路摇摇欲坠。
chunks: He usually keeps his ground just long enough
for his own ruin, and is then thrust out,
with sinews all unstrung,
to totter along the difficult footpath
of life as he best may.

text: Uncle Sam’s gold—meaning no disrespect to the worthy old gentleman—has, in this respect, a quality of enchantment like that of the devil’s wages.
zh: 山姆大叔的黄金——无意冒犯这位可敬的老绅士——在这方面具有类似于魔鬼工资的魔力。
chunks: Uncle Sam’s gold— meaning no disrespect
to the worthy old gentleman— has,
in this respect, a quality
of enchantment like
that of the devil’s wages.

text: I endeavoured to calculate how much longer I could stay in the Custom-House, and yet go forth a man.
zh: 我努力计算着我能在海关待多久，然后才能出去。
chunks: I endeavoured
to calculate
how much longer I could stay
in the Custom-House,
and yet go forth a man.

text: A remarkable event of the third year of my Surveyorship—to adopt the tone of “P.
zh: 我担任测量员第三年的一件了不起的事情——采用“P.
chunks: A remarkable event
of the third year
of my Surveyorship—
to adopt the tone
of “P.

text: There are few uglier traits of human nature than this tendency—which I now witnessed in men no worse than their neighbours—to grow cruel, merely because they possessed the power of inflicting harm.
zh: 人性中没有什么比这种倾向更丑陋的了——我现在在不比他们的邻居更糟糕的人身上看到这种倾向——仅仅因为他们拥有造成伤害的力量而变得残忍。
chunks: There are few uglier traits
of human nature than this tendency—
which I now witnessed in men no worse
than their neighbours— to grow cruel,
merely because they possessed the power of inflicting harm.

text: In short, unpleasant as was my predicament, at best, I saw much reason to congratulate myself that I was on the losing side rather than the triumphant one.
zh: 简而言之，尽管我的困境令人不快，但充其量，我有充分的理由庆贺自己，因为我是失败的一方，而不是胜利的一方。
chunks: In short, unpleasant as was my predicament,
at best, I saw much reason
to congratulate myself that I was
on the losing side rather
than the triumphant one.

text: In view of my previous weariness of office, and vague thoughts of resignation, my fortune somewhat resembled that of a person who should entertain an idea of committing suicide, and although beyond his hopes, meet with the good hap to be murdered.
chunks: In view of my previous weariness of office, and vague thoughts
of resignation, my fortune somewhat resembled
that of a person who should entertain an idea
of committing suicide, and although beyond his hopes,
meet with the good hap to be murdered.

text: Surveyor Pue, came into play.
zh: 测量员普埃登场。
chunks: Surveyor Pue,
came into play.

text: My blessing on my friends!
zh: 我对我的朋友们的祝福！
chunks: My blessing
on my friends!

text: Henceforth it ceases to be a reality of my life; I am a citizen of somewhere else.
zh: 从此以后，它不再是我生活的现实；我是其他地方的公民。
chunks: Henceforth it ceases
to be a reality
of my life;
I am a citizen
of somewhere else.

text: The rust on the ponderous iron-work of its oaken door looked more antique than anything else in the New World.
zh: 橡木门笨重的铁制品上的锈迹看起来比新世界的任何东西都要古老。
chunks: The rust
on the ponderous iron-work
of its oaken door looked more antique
than anything else
in the New World.

text: Amongst any other population, or at a later period in the history of New England, the grim rigidity that petrified the bearded physiognomies of these good people would have augured some awful business in hand.
zh: 在任何其他人口中，或者在新英格兰历史的后期，这些好人的胡须面貌都僵化了，这预示着即将发生一些可怕的事情。
chunks: Amongst any other population, or at a later period
in the history of New England,
the grim rigidity that petrified the bearded physiognomies
of these good people would have augured some awful business
